summary.text: Tynley Bean is the Utah Forward Party candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 29, an open seat with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner and art educator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on government accountability and family court reform.

paragraphs.text: Tynley Bean earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University-Idaho in 2004, and her career experience includes working as a small business owner and educator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an art educator, a mother of five and the operator of a small farm with llamas, alpacas, goats and chickens.
Bean said her Impact Audit Initiative would require major bills and incentives of $4 million or more to set measurable goals up front and track results.
She also named family court reform as a priority, including changing litigation cost incentives, improving custody order enforcement and increasing accountability in child welfare investigations.
